Risk & Responsibility - Contractor bears most of the risk for [...] \ EPC Contracts: Where Engineering Meets Legal Precision\ In large-scale infrastructure and energy projects, \EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) contracts\ form the backbone of execution — and the legal structuring of these contracts can make or break project success. From a legal perspective, a well-drafted EPC contract should address: \Clear scope definition\ and performance standards \Risk allocation\ — delays, force majeure, cost overruns \LDs (Liquidated Damages)\ for delay or [...] for delay or performance failures \Payment terms, milestone triggers, and retention\ \Change order procedures and dispute resolution mechanisms\ Interface clarity with sub-contractors or third parties \Termination rights\ and indemnity provisions Whether in power, urban infrastructure, or industrial construction — \EPC contracts demand not just legal knowledge but deep commercial and technical understanding\. The goal? Contracts that are fair, protective, and execution-ready. #EPCContracts
